title: Viral Re-Infestation
html:
Quest Giver: Soldier Clohz of Yorbahk

Quest Type: GoTo / Kill

Quest Description: Kill 45 Poison Whisker Broodlings, 30 Poison Venomspitters, 25 Forest Blademasters, and Find and Destroy the Source of the Infection then Return to Soldier Clohz of Yorbahk on Level 1 of the Widower's Nest.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Soldier Clohz of Yorbahk

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Widower's Nest

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill 45 Poison Whisker Broodlings, 30 Poison Venomspitters, 25 Forest Blademasters, and Find and Destroy the Source of the Infection then Return to Soldier Clohz of Yorbahk on Level 1 of the Widower's Nest.

Offer:

Ready for another security scan on upper Widower's Nest? You know the drill, search out any Poison Whisker Broodlings, Venomspitters, and Blademasters and take them out. Also be on the lookout for the source of the infection.

The hard part is done, now we just need to keep checking for the infections to make sure the dungeon doesn't get another virus. I think that a soldier was using the dungeon to fish for some prawn during work time, but all prawn fishing sites have been blocked since the Malicious Crustaceans Invasion.

Turn-in:

All clear? Excellent! Here is your reward Dungeon Runner. Let me know if you want to do another scan.

Objectives:

  • Slain Poison Whisker Broodlings
  • Slain Poison Venomspitters
  • Slain Forest Blademaster
  • Find the Source of the Infection
  • Destroy the Source of the Infection

Level range: 23–40
